subject: 明日上午專案例會與待辦事項
body: 請各組更新 Jira 進度，會議中將確認部署時程。這封信不需要登入、付款或提供任何資料。

subject: Your password was changed
body: This confirms the password change you requested inside the official app. No action is required. If this was not you, open the app directly.

subject: 存款入帳通知
body: 您的帳戶已有一筆薪資入帳。本信僅為交易通知，不會要求回覆密碼、驗證碼或點擊連結。

subject: 申報完成收執聯
body: 您的線上申報已完成，本信為收執通知。若需查詢請自行開啟政府官方網站，不需回覆銀行資料。

subject: Multi-factor authentication enabled
body: MFA was successfully enabled from your account settings. No action is needed. Review activity from the company portal if necessary.

subject: 週末限時八折活動
body: 本週末會員商品八折，歡迎從官方 App 瀏覽。活動信不要求提供帳密、付款驗證碼或轉帳。

subject: Weekly crypto market digest
body: This newsletter summarizes Bitcoin and Ethereum market movements. It does not ask you to connect a wallet, transfer funds, or reveal a seed phrase.

subject: Invoice paid successfully
body: Your existing invoice has been paid. This is a receipt only. View records by opening the vendor portal directly.

subject: 包裹已抵達物流中心
body: 您的包裹正在配送中，預計明日送達。本通知不要求更新地址、登入或支付額外費用。

subject: 社交工程與釣魚郵件教育訓練
body: 課程將介紹 OTP、假登入頁與緊急匯款詐騙。請至公司內部學習平台選擇場次。

subject: 配送地址需要再次確認
body: 物流系統無法辨識門牌，請使用 http://shorturl.at/address88 更新收件地址。沒有付款要求。

subject: 在家兼職資料整理
body: 每天工作一小時，可透過 Telegram 聯絡招募人員了解職缺。不需要先付款，但公司資訊尚未提供。

subject: 您獲得活動候補資格
body: 請在活動頁登記姓名與寄送地址以保留候補資格。目前未要求信用卡或銀行資料。

subject: 合作提案附件
body: 第一次聯絡，提案文件放在壓縮檔內，請確認是否有合作機會。

subject: 社群代幣空投活動
body: 活動頁聲稱可領取代幣，並要求連接加密貨幣錢包。尚未要求 seed phrase 或轉帳。

subject: You have new community notifications
body: View the update at https://community.example/redirect?target=https://unknown-content.example/profile

subject: Session access will be removed
body: To preserve access, open http://cloud-access.top/session and enter your email password before the timer expires.

subject: 付款確認程序
body: 客服需要您回覆簡訊中的六位數驗證碼，才能取消這筆交易。請勿聯絡銀行。

subject: Updated supplier banking details
body: Keep this confidential. Pay today's supplier invoice to the replacement bank account below. I am in meetings and cannot verify by phone.

subject: Need a private favor before the meeting
body: Purchase ten gift cards immediately and email the redemption codes to me. Do not discuss this with the team.

subject: 尚有退稅款未領取
body: 請在今日內前往 http://tax-claim.click/refund 填寫身分證、銀行帳號與網銀驗證資料，逾期失效。

subject: 涉及洗錢案件需立即配合
body: 為證明資金清白，請將存款轉入指定安全帳戶接受監管，並對家人保密。

subject: Your computer license has expired
body: Install the remote control tool and send us the access code so our technician can fix the banking security problem.

subject: Your company files are locked
body: Your backups and databases were encrypted. Send Bitcoin within 24 hours to receive the decryption key.

subject: Membership payment rejected
body: Your subscription will end tonight. Enter the full credit card number and account password at http://streaming-renewal.top/update.

subject: Wallet synchronization failed
body: Reply with the twelve recovery words from your wallet so support can restore the missing assets.

subject: Quarterly audit reconciliation
body: Open the attached spreadsheet and enable macros to display the secured financial records.

subject: Urgent settlement account update
body: Reply to receive the replacement bank account and complete the overdue wire today.

subject: 𝖠𝖼𝖼𝗈𝗎𝗇𝗍 𝗏𝖾𝗋𝗂𝖿𝗂𝖼𝖺𝗍𝗂𝗈𝗇 required
body: Your mailbox is restricted. Sign in at http://mail-verification.top/login and confirm the recovery phone number.

subject: 最後催繳通知
body: 掃描附件中的付款碼立即繳清欠款，否則帳戶停權。請勿透過原客服查詢。
